template.title: Minimal Python project
template.summary: Sane defaults for a small Python repo: replay provider, scenarios/, the starter scenario.

note: Minimal Python project — replay provider, modest loop policy, hello-dev-loop scenario.

config.yaml:
# dev-loop configuration for this repository.
#
# Template: minimal-python

runs_dir: .dev-loop/runs
default_provider: replay
scenarios_dir: scenarios

policy:
  max_code_iterations: 5
  max_validation_attempts_per_iteration: 2
  max_diagnostic_rounds_per_failure: 3
  max_total_wall_clock_minutes: 60

notes: minimal-python template

# Hello, dev-loop

This is the starter scenario. The agent (in replay mode) will
pretend to implement a tiny change and the harness will report a
passing E2E. Use it to verify your setup before pointing dev-loop
at a real task.
